name: smartsuite
label: SmartSuite
description: Collaborative work management platform combining databases with spreadsheets.

create_record.label: Create a Record
create_record.description: Creates a new record in the specified table.

update_record.label: Update a Record
update_record.description: Updates an existing record in the specified table

get_solution.label: Get Solution
get_solution.description: Gets the details of one solution.

get_solution_by_id.label: Get Solution (by ID)
get_solution_by_id.description: Gets the details of one solution, by solution ID.

solutionId.label: Solution ID
solutionId.description: The SmartSuite solution ID (24 characters). Get it from List Solutions.

get_table_schema.label: Get Table Schema
get_table_schema.description: Gets a table and its fields (slug, label, type and choices).

get_table_schema_by_id.label: Get Table Schema (by ID)
get_table_schema_by_id.description: Gets a table and its fields (slug, label, type and choices), by table ID.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

upsert_record.label: Create or Update Record
upsert_record.description: Updates the record whose field matches a value, or creates it when none matches.

matchField.label: Match Field
matchField.description: The field that identifies the record, for example an email or external ID field.

restore_record.label: Restore Record
restore_record.description: Brings a deleted record back from the trash.

recordId.label: Deleted Record
recordId.description: A record in the trash of the selected table.

restore_record_by_id.label: Restore Record (by ID)
restore_record_by_id.description: Brings a deleted record back from the trash, by table ID and record ID.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.

add_comment.label: Add Comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a record.

assignedTo.label: Assign To
assignedTo.description: Optional member to assign the comment to.

add_comment_by_id.label: Add Comment (by ID)
add_comment_by_id.description: Adds a comment to a record, by table ID and record ID.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.

assignedTo.label: Assign To (Member ID)
assignedTo.description: Optional member ID to assign the comment to. Get it from List Members.

get_member_by_id.label: Get Member (by ID)
get_member_by_id.description: Gets one workspace member by member ID.

memberId.label: Member ID
memberId.description: The member ID. Get it from List Members.

download_record_file_by_handle.label: Get File Download URL (by Handle)
download_record_file_by_handle.description: Gets a temporary download link for one file, by its file handle.

fileHandle.label: File Handle
fileHandle.description: The "handle" of the file, found in the record's Files & Images field.

get_record_by_id.label: Get Record (by ID)
get_record_by_id.description: Gets one record by table ID and record ID, keyed by field slug.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The SmartSuite table (application) ID. Get it from List Tables.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The record ID. Get it from List Records or a create step.
